text_block_list.text:
On this day, when I went shopping
with Sakura Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oho? What is that...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a raffle, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"And what's more, Trainer!
We have the lottery tickets we received
when we bought that horseshoe polish earlier!"
choice_data_list: Do you want to draw one?
Do you want to draw one?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmm. But after getting their hopes up, drawing a dud would make me feel so bad~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Shall we draw it together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If we pull it together, even if it's a bad draw,
we can accept it as just how things were meant to be.
...Ehehe.

Accepting Sakura Chiyono O's suggestion,
the two of us spin the raffle wheel's lever together.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...Huh!? Wha... WHAT!?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer!
W-We...! That... you know, that thing!!
choice_data_list: Amazing, you won the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. The grand prize!
I won the grand prize!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's the grand prize! The grand prize!!

Carried away by the excitement, Sakura Chiyono O
grabbed my hand and started hopping up and down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Hehe, what should we do?! It's the top prize!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you two get along so well, like brother and sister.
Are you going on the trip together?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you two get along so well, like sisters.
Are you going on the trip together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, um... !?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't this just for one person?
Is it really okay for me to come along too?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course!
We can't have you thinking our shopping district is too stingy to prepare for more than one person!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that so...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then, if it's okay!
Trainer.
Um, may I come along with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If it had only been for one person, I was planning to give it to you, Trainer, but if we can go together, then I'd love to go...
choice_data_list: Of course! But are you sure you want to go with me?
Of course! But are you sure you're fine with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! In fact, it's *because* it's with you that I want to go!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When should we schedule our trip?
We're still pretty busy right now, so, umm...
choice_data_list: Maybe once everything is over and things settle down?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right! Heheh, once the dates are set, I'll have to put together a travel itinerary too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, going on a hot spring trip might be the first time since I went with my family!
I hope they have karaoke~!

If I remember correctly, that hot spring inn offered as a prize
is a facility where many Umamusume go for therapeutic baths
to recover from fatigue.
When that time comes, I'll make sure she takes it easy and cares for her own body as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, looks delicious!
Thank you, mister!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Haha, the only reason you hit the jackpot is because luck was on your side, missy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"She's clearly such a good girl~.
Good deeds really do pay off."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? E-ehehe...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so, I wonder...?
Th-Thank you very much...
choice_data_list: Yes, Chiyono O is a serious and good girl.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hawaah, not you too, Trainer-san!?
Don't just praise me out of nowhere like that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in my diligence, but...
hearing you call me such a good girl is a bit...
choice_data_list: Chiyono O is a good girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hyawaaa...
Th-That's a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer is a good person too, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's because you're such a good person that we won first prize when we drew together, Trainer!
So, um, it wasn't just my luck!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's like, adding a nice person and a slightly good girl together helped us win an amazing award...!
Um, I think that's how it is!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, um, er.
Thank you so much for 1st place!?

Sakura Chiyono O dashed out of the room,
clutching her cheeks in embarrassment.

As an apology,
I decided to let her have the prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I can't even see the bottom of the box...!
It's totally packed with orange...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, with this much, even if we cook whole meals with it, it'll last for two days!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Heheh, leave it to me. I'll show you the chanko nabe skills my mom taught me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We'll treat you to three full meals—
lunch, dinner, and late-night snacks—for the whole day!
choice_data_list: So evening and night are different...?
Are evening and night different things...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true... Even if I'm fine with it,
it might put you in a tough spot, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Barging into Trainer's room
in the middle of the night would be quite rude...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Understood, I have a plan!!
And that night...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~, would you mind
opening the door for me~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
Chiyo's special chanko delivery complete!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I packed enough not just for dinner, but for a late-night snack too.
Come on, please enjoy!

On the desk sat a pot of a size I'd never seen before.
Inside it, carrots were packed together like beautiful roses...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've seen this carrot before!
It's that brand that's been making waves lately...
'Sweet-Sweet Carrots', right!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Oh? Do you know about it, little miss?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it was featured on TV yesterday!
They said once you put it on your tongue, the sweetness just bursts right out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ehehe...
So sweet... I want to eat it soon...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll let Chiyono O have it then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I'm so sorry for getting carried away
all by myself... I wish I could just crawl into a hole...

Sakura Chiyono O's face quickly turned bright red.
Even though there was only one carrot,
I decided to let her eat the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy... I really messed up...
Trainer, I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh. However...
choice_data_list: Since we both drew it, "it can't be helped."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... that's true.
Then let's split the sadness in half too.

Sharing in our frustration together,
Sakura Chiyono O and I headed back to the academy.
